name: Aloo Methi with Tofu and Roasted Chana
ingredients: 3 packed cups fresh methi leaves, washed and chopped
1 tsp (5 ml) canola or mustard oil
steps: Dice potato into small cubes. Parboil for 4–5 minutes, then drain well.
Wash methi thoroughly, remove tough stems and chop. Press tofu and crumble it.
Heat measured oil in a non-stick pan. Add cumin, ginger and chilli; stir briefly.
Add potato, turmeric and coriander. Cover and cook until almost tender, adding a spoonful of water if needed.
Add tofu and cook 3–4 minutes, stirring to lightly brown and heat through.
Fold in methi and cook until wilted and excess moisture evaporates.
Turn off heat. Add crushed roasted chana, amchur and lemon. Taste and season modestly.
note: Keeps the familiar aloo-methi flavour but increases methi and adds tofu. Potato still contributes carbohydrate; keep the serving measured and pair with another non-starchy vegetable. Roasted chana adds crunch and fibre but also carbohydrate. Vegetarian; vegan if no dairy garnish is added.
